Build: Refactor Bill and Transaction View Controllers to use custom text fields for date and options selection

- Replaced UIDatePicker and UIButton with DatePickerTextField and OptionsPickerTextField in HandleBillViewController and HandleTransactionViewController for better keyboard navigation.
- Updated the setup methods to refresh options for categories and wallets.
- Improved keyboard toolbar functionality to include dynamic accessory buttons based on field state.
- Added new components: DatePickerTextField and OptionsPickerTextField for enhanced user experience.
- Adjusted the layout and order of fields in the table view for better usability.
- Updated TODO.md to reflect completed tasks related to the new implementations.
